
            <div class="postcontent">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<section id="mp-md" style="-webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; text-autospace: normal; text-align: left; padding: 1em; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.75; word-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">在各类企业级应用中，程序化修改 Word 文档是一个高频需求——批量更新合同模板中的占位符、动态生成个性化的报告与报价单、统一标准化文档中的术语表述等。实现这类需求的核心技术挑战在于：Word 文档采用复杂的内置结构存储文本与格式，简单的字符串操作极易破坏文档的格式完整性，导致输出结果无法满足正式应用的标准。</span></p>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">Free Spire.Doc for .NET 是一套在无需本地安装 Microsoft Office 环境下直接操作 Word 文档的免费 .NET API，其 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">Document</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 和 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">Paragraph</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 类提供了 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">Replace</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 和 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">FindAllString</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 等多个文本查找与替换的重载方法，支持普通字符串、正则表达式匹配等场景。以下将从基础用法到高级技巧逐步展开。</span></p>
<hr>
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 36px 0 24px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: bold; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 24px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">环境准备</span></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">将 Free Spire.Doc 添加到项目中最便捷的方式是通过 NuGet 包管理器。在 Visual Studio 的“管理 NuGet 程序包”中搜索 FreeSpire.Doc 并安装，或在包管理器控制台中执行以下命令：</span></p>
<pre class="highlighter-hljs" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 20px 0; padding: 0; background: rgba(246, 250, 248, 1); border-top: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-right: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-left: 3px solid rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden"><code>Install-Package FreeSpire.Doc</code></pre>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">安装完成后，在代码文件顶部引入核心命名空间：</span></p>
<pre class="highlighter-hljs" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 20px 0; padding: 0; background: rgba(246, 250, 248, 1); border-top: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-right: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-left: 3px solid rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden"><code>using Spire.Doc;
using Spire.Doc.Documents;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 36px 0 24px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: bold; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 24px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">基础示例：替换 Word 中的指定文本</span></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">用到的免费 .NET 库的核心替换方法是 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">Document.Replace(string matchString, string newValue, bool caseSensitive, bool wholeWord)</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">，该方法在整个文档范围内查找指定的字符串并将其替换为新文本。</span></p>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: bold; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1)">参数说明</strong><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">：</span></p>
<ul style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 8px 0; padding-left: 20px; list-style-type: disc; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1)">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; line-height: 1.6; padding-left: 0; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">matchString</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">：要查找的目标文本</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; line-height: 1.6; padding-left: 0; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">newValue</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">：替换后的新文本</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; line-height: 1.6; padding-left: 0; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">caseSensitive</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">：是否区分大小写（</span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">true</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 为区分，</span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">false</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 为不区分）</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; line-height: 1.6; padding-left: 0; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">wholeWord</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">：是否仅匹配完整单词（</span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">true</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 时仅替换独立的完整单词）</span></li>
</ul>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">以下示例演示将文档中的旧公司名称替换为新名称：</span></p>
<pre class="highlighter-hljs" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 20px 0; padding: 0; background: rgba(246, 250, 248, 1); border-top: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-right: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-left: 3px solid rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden"><code>public static void BasicReplace(string inputPath, string outputPath)
{
    // 创建 Document 对象并加载文档
    Document document = new Document();
    document.LoadFromFile(inputPath);
    
    // 执行替换操作：不区分大小写，匹配完整单词
    document.Replace("old_company_name", "NewTech Solutions Inc.", false, true);
    
    // 保存修改后的文档
    document.SaveToFile(outputPath, FileFormat.Docx);
    document.Close();
}</code></pre>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">该方法在替换过程中能够保留原文本的格式与排版，确保文档的其他元素（如图片、表格、页眉页脚等）不受影响。</span></p>
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 36px 0 24px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: bold; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 24px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">可选：仅替换首次出现的文本</span></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">若业务需求仅需将文档中第一次出现的目标文本进行替换，可在调用 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">Replace</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 方法之前将 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">Document.ReplaceFirst</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 属性设置为 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">true</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">：</span></p>
<pre class="highlighter-hljs" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 20px 0; padding: 0; background: rgba(246, 250, 248, 1); border-top: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-right: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-left: 3px solid rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden"><code>public static void ReplaceFirstInstance(string inputPath, string outputPath)
{
    Document document = new Document();
    document.LoadFromFile(inputPath);
    
    // 将替换模式设置为仅替换第一个匹配项
    document.ReplaceFirst = true;
    document.Replace("placeholder", "actual value", false, true);
    
    document.SaveToFile(outputPath, FileFormat.Docx);
    document.Close();
}</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 36px 0 24px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: bold; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 24px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">进阶：使用正则表达式进行模式匹配替换</span></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">对于需要匹配某种模式而非固定字符串的场景（例如替换所有占位符 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">{{...}}</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">、匹配特定格式的编号等），可以使用 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">Document.Replace(Regex regex, string newValue)</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 方法的重载版本。</span></p>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">以下示例展示如何将文档中所有由花括号包裹的占位符替换为指定的值：</span></p>
<pre class="highlighter-hljs" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 20px 0; padding: 0; background: rgba(246, 250, 248, 1); border-top: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-right: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-left: 3px solid rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden"><code>using System.Text.RegularExpressions;

public static void RegexReplace(string inputPath, string outputPath)
{
    Document document = new Document();
    document.LoadFromFile(inputPath);
    
    // 匹配形如 {{placeholder}} 的占位符模式
    Regex placeholderRegex = new Regex(@"\{\{.*?\}\}");
    
    // 将所有匹配的占位符替换为目标字符串
    document.Replace(placeholderRegex, "replacement text");
    
    document.SaveToFile(outputPath, FileFormat.Docx);
    document.Close();
}</code></pre>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">更复杂的使用场景中，还可调用 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">Replace(Regex, TextSelection)</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 等重载变体进行带格式的替换操作。</span></p>
<hr>
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 36px 0 24px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: bold; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 24px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">扩展：查找文本并做进一步处理（查找高亮）</span></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">除了直接替换，</span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">Document.FindAllString</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 方法可以获取所有匹配的 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">TextSelection</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 对象集合，便于在替换前对匹配结果进行预览、统计，或在替换后应用格式设置（如高亮显示）。</span></p>
<pre class="highlighter-hljs" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 20px 0; padding: 0; background: rgba(246, 250, 248, 1); border-top: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-right: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-left: 3px solid rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden"><code>using System.Drawing;

public static void FindAndHighlight(string inputPath, string outputPath)
{
    Document document = new Document();
    document.LoadFromFile(inputPath);
    
    // 查找所有匹配的文本
    TextSelection[] selections = document.FindAllString("keyword", false, true);
    
    foreach (TextSelection selection in selections)
    {
        // 将匹配的文本设置为高亮黄色
        selection.GetAsOneRange().CharacterFormat.HighlightColor = Color.Yellow;
    }
    
    document.SaveToFile(outputPath, FileFormat.Docx);
    document.Close();
}</code></pre>
<hr style="box-sizing: border-box; border: none; height: 2px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0), rgba(43, 174, 133, 1), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)); margin: 32px 0">
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 36px 0 24px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: bold; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 24px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">总结</span></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">本文提供了一套较为完整的 Word 文档文本替换示例：从基础的 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">Replace</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 字符串替换、仅替换首次出现、正则表达式模式匹配，到 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">FindAllString</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 查找并做格式调整，基本覆盖了 .NET 环境下 Word 文档批量处理的常见需求。</span></p>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 0; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">在实际项目中，建议根据文档规模和业务复杂度选择合适的替换策略；对于需要格式保留的复杂内容场景，可进一步利用其他重载或自行封装处理。</span></p>
</section>
